summary: The pack already covers all four KCs with solid misconceptions, worked examples, 40 items and teach cards; add three library figures that show the orbital overlap and planarity the note currently only describes in words.

improvements.caption: Sigma bonds formed by end-on overlap of s and p orbitals
improvements.where: note, in the σ/π bonds paragraph (after "A σ bond forms by end-on overlap along the line joining two nuclei.")
improvements.why: The note states end-on overlap forms a σ bond in words only; this figure shows s–s, s–p and p–p end-on overlap producing symmetrical σ electron density, which diagrams.py has no matching type for (orbital-overlap is not in the diagram table) and is legible and self-contained.

improvements.caption: Pi bonds formed by sideways overlap of p orbitals
improvements.where: note, in the σ/π bonds paragraph (after the σ bond figure, before "A single bond contains one σ bond.")
improvements.why: Pairs with the σ-bond figure to show the sideways p-orbital overlap and the two lobes above/below the σ framework that the note's π bond sentence describes only in words; no diagram type in PACK.md draws orbital lobes.

improvements.caption: Ethene's two trigonal planar centres share one plane
improvements.where: note, in the Planar paragraph (after "All six atoms in ethene are planar...")
improvements.why: Shows directly why all six ethene nuclei are coplanar by overlaying the two trigonal-planar triangles at each carbon, the exact claim the Planar paragraph and the m5 misconception address; apparatus/molecular-geometry figures of this kind are not in the diagram table.
